sahneler.metin: A gas explosion levelled two buildings in East Harlem.
They collapsed in seconds, and eight people were killed.
A gas leak call came minutes before.
Two gas pipe welds were faulty.
A hole in a nearby sewer had washed away the soil beneath them.
The NTSB faulted both the utility and the city.

aciklama:
East Harlem destroyed two buildings in Manhattan. The cause: faulty welds plus soil washed away by a leaking sewer, letting the pipe sag and crack.
